WRITES: LAB-only client financial profile rendering layered after the existing cliRender
LAB-only responsive financial profile styles scoped to #pageClientes
Focused synthetic regression test for financial profile hierarchy, urgency ordering and non-mutation invariants
DOM_AFFECTED: LAB-only .lab-fin-* descendants injected inside existing client expansion panels
Existing client header remains the compact identity entry point
STATE_AFFECTED: Ephemeral LAB visual credit-view selection per client
Preservation of currently expanded client cards across cliRender refreshes
STORAGE_AFFECTED: None: no localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, D1 LAB, R2, Supabase, Railway or production storage writes
DOMAIN_INVARIANTS: Debt and pending balances are consumed from the existing credit model and are never recalculated into persisted fields.
Payments continue exclusively through the existing abrirPago flow; no second payment implementation is introduced.
Payment history remains sourced from each credit pagos ledger and existing credit-detail flow.
Credit-line eligibility and available amount are consumed from _naEvaluateClientCredit without changing its formula or policy.
FIFO, reversals, cash movements, OUTBOX, synchronization and historical balances remain unchanged.
POS/** remains untouched and LAB never becomes production data authority.
CROSS_MODULE_IMPACT: Clientes becomes a richer read-only visual consumer of existing Créditos, Pagos and credit-evaluation state.
The existing payment modal, credit detail modal and evaluation modal remain the only action paths from the new profile.
The shared mobile scroll-linked controller is not modified; only dynamic content height changes and is covered by regression tests.
Products, inventory, sales, cash, expenses, OUTBOX and synchronization receive no code changes.
RISKS: Legacy credits can have missing or imprecise due dates, so urgency must degrade to neutral labels instead of invented dates.
A normal cliRender refresh can rebuild client cards and accidentally collapse the currently opened profile.
Older payment records may omit operation, cashier or canonical time fields and must display a dash without fabrication.
The richer mobile profile increases page height and could expose regressions in sticky/scroll-linked chrome.
